rootCause: S24broray-light stop sent TERM to the daemon, removed its PID file, and returned without waiting for the old shell process to run its cleanup trap. The following start launched a new daemon and wrote the same PID file; delayed cleanup by the old daemon then removed the new PID file. Immediate updater health status therefore failed and correctly triggered rollback.

requiredSemantics: bounded KILL escalation only for still-owned processes
stale and duplicate owned-daemon cleanup before start
fail closed on foreign live PID-file owner
status requires exact owned daemon and lighttpd PIDs
